description: Choose restaurant menus by Google Maps place URL/ID or search by cuisine and city, then collect dishes, sections, descriptions, prices and place context.

includePlacesWithoutMenu.description: Return one summary row for a restaurant whose menu cannot be read, so every input place is accounted for.
includePlacesWithoutMenu.title: Include places without a menu

includePopularDishes.description: Also check Google's own inline menu when it is available and mark dishes Google labels Popular. This uses a browser and is slower.
includePopularDishes.title: Include popular dishes

language.description: Language used for Google Maps place lookups and search results.
language.title: Language

maxItemsPerPlace.description: Maximum menu rows to return for each restaurant.
maxItemsPerPlace.title: Max items per place

maxPlacesPerQuery.description: Maximum restaurants to process from each search query (mode=bySearch).
maxPlacesPerQuery.title: Max places per query

mode.description: How to choose restaurants: paste place URLs/IDs or run a Google Maps search query.
enumTitles: Restaurants by URL or Place ID
mode.title: Mode

placeUrls.description: One restaurant per line (mode=byPlace). Accepts Google Maps place URLs, short maps.app.goo.gl links, canonical ChIJ Place IDs, and 0x…:0x… feature IDs.
placeUrls.title: Place URLs or Place IDs

searchQueries.description: Cuisine + city queries, e.g. `italian restaurant, New York` or `sushi in Austin` (mode=bySearch). Each query returns up to Max places per query.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

title: Google Maps Restaurant Menu Scraper Input
